Tracks the caller rollout for #295 after releases of pm-changelog and the reusable pm-github workflows are available.

The audited caller workflows in pm-beads, pm-presets, pm-brief, pm-web, pm-ops, pm-glossary, pm-vcs, pm-swarm and pm-slack-standup currently pin the older workflow behavior. Repin those callers and verify that tracker-only sync and closeout candidates pass the consuming project's checks. Remove explicit `changelog:full` overrides only when their sole purpose is regenerating the changelog. Retain custom checks such as pm-presets' `closeout:check`.

pm-vcs is a coupled artifact caller. Its sync and closeout call `self-host:tracker-candidate`, which regenerates and stages `CHANGELOG.md` before writing `selfhost.bundle`. Its bundle verification includes the committed changelog. Update the workflow-only generator to build from the staged tracker and committed changelog when adopting tracker-only publication. Verify the bundle against the resulting commit, and keep release-time generation intact.

The independently strict caller changelog checks in pm-ops, pm-slack, pm-gantt-chart and pm-review are already tracked in unbraind/pm-changelog#385. Validate the caller's read-only exit policy before repinning a workflow that relies on a custom check.
Roll out tracker-only sync and closeout to reusable workflow callers
